summary: AB Private Credit Investors Corp filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its revolving credit facility, increasing the facility sublimit from $35M to $42M. The amendment was with HSBC Bank USA as administrative agent and lender, along with other borrowers and general partners. No terms such as price per share, premium, or consideration were stated as this is a debt facility modification. No board recommendation or advisors were named. The filing is a routine current report on a material definitive agreement involving an ordinary credit line increase, not a special situation.
